title: Active Trader Sales: Options Lead
location_raw: New York City or US Remote
description:
About Public

Public is building the Agentic Brokerage. Focused on serious investors who use AI and a vast variety of asset classes, from stocks and bonds to crypto and options, to build their portfolios. Launched in 2019, Public has been trusted with billions of assets from retail investors.

What you'll do:

You'll own the acquisition, advocacy, and retention of high-volume options traders at Public by working across every function and leveraging every asset we have to bring them onto the platform. That means building and maintaining a pipeline of high-potential prospects from both Public-generated and outbound channels, and, where useful, identifying and working with external partners to hit your goals. Options volume is your north star: you'll figure out where sophisticated flow lives, meet traders where they are, and do whatever it takes (within regulatory limits) to bring that volume to Public.

Public is the Agentic Brokerage, and options traders are among the most sophisticated users of our platform. You'll be the connective tissue between our product and the trader community by evangelizing our AI Agents, API access, and options tooling to the traders who'll push them hardest, then channeling what you hear back to product and engineering. You'll need to know our API and agentic capabilities well enough to demo them credibly and win over traders who build their own systems.

This is a role for someone who works well independently and enjoys owning their approach. You'll have real autonomy and a clear target, with the flexibility to figure out the path that works best.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years experience working in a premier consumer finance and/or capital markets organization
  • Series 7, Series 4 and/or 63/66 (or immediate path to completing)
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in options trading: single-leg and multi-leg strategies, spreads, volatility, and the mechanics of how serious options traders actually operate
  • Track record of sales and/or direct customer acquisition success
  • Experience working within regulatory compliance constraints to deliver business outcomes
  • Ability to build processes and approaches for acquiring clients from a blank slate
  • Creative problem solver on behalf of company and clients
  • Ability to represent the firm and speak publicly, including in options-trader communities
  • Intellectual curiosity
  • Active Public member and options trader (sign up today!)

Bonus Points:

  • Deep understanding of all tools and asset classes in an active trader's arsenal, with options as your specialty
  • Existing relationships or credibility within options-trading communities (Discord, X/FinTwit, Reddit, trading meetups, etc.)
  • Experience working with or selling to API-based and high-frequency options traders
  • Equity capital markets, trading, and/or research experience
  • Experience with markets and financial data (e.g., exchange data, options chains, fundamental data)
  • Ability to use modern AI tools to scale your productivity and impact
  • Fluency with data (and interest in learning) SQL and/or Python programming languages

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • Uncapped bonus structure based on sales performance
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans
  • Generous PTO and parental leave policy
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Opportunities for career growth and professional development

Public is an equal employment opportunity employer to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. We celebrate people of all race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression.

title: Lifecycle Marketing Lead
description:
About Us:

Public is building the Agentic Brokerage. Focused on serious investors who use AI and a vast variety of asset classes, from stocks and bonds to crypto and options, to build their portfolios. Launched in 2019, Public has been trusted with billions of assets from retail investors.

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our team at Public.com. This role will focus on driving new user conversion and early engagement, and will be instrumental in increasing LTV and retention across the customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate will be an expert in lifecycle marketing strategy, combining analytical storytelling with creative problem solving. This is a highly visible, cross-functional role that partners closely with product, engineering, data, and brand to build, test, and optimize lifecycle programs.

This role is based in NYC and will be onsite Monday through Thursday.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and execute lifecycle strategy for active traders, optimizing for first-time investments and multi-product adoption.
  • Own the strategy, messaging, and technical success of all active trader messaging.
  • Build and maintain Braze canvasses, emails, push notifications, and deep in-app integrations, with regular reports on your results to executive leadership.
  • Collaborate with product, brand, and data to identify new opportunities to improve conversion rates and channel performance.
  • Analyze performance, leveraging Mixpanel, Looker, and other analytics tools to identify trends and performance optimization opportunities
  • Drive experimentation and A/B testing to iterate and refine messages, improving conversion rates and LTV.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends and changes, ensuring Public.com remains at the forefront of lifecycle marketing innovations.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 4+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing strategies and channels, including email, push, in-app messaging, SMS, and direct mail
  • Expertise in lifecycle marketing tools, preferably Braze
  • Comfortable writing HTML, CSS, and Liquid or similar templating language
    • SQL, JSON, and webhook expertise a bonus
  • Excellent writing skills and deep knowledge of email design best practices
  • Experience running successful A/B tests optimizing new user conversion.
  • Strong understanding of attribution models, incrementality testing, and marketing analytics.
  • Proven ability to optimize funnel conversion, retention, user engagement, and LTV
  • Proficiency with marketing and product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Looker, etc.).
  • Strong analytical skills, comfortable making data-driven decisions.
  • A proactive and entrepreneurial mindset, with a passion for testing and learning.
  • Strong preference for candidates with experience in fintech.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans
  • Generous PTO and parental leave policy
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Opportunities for career growth and professional development

Public is an equal employment opportunity employer to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. We celebrate people of all race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression. The compensation range for this role is $160K-$190K based on skills and experience.
